newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Sept industry output down 6.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russia Sept industry output down 6.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Russian industrial production rose one percent in September on August but was 6.8 percent lower than a year earlier, the State Statistics Committee said on Tuesday.
It said industrial production for the first nine months was 5.5 percent lower than for the same period in 1995. The committee released the following data:
RUSSIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT SEPT 96 AUG 96 SEPT 95
Note - Official Russian data tend to underreport a growing private sector in the economy.
